action.name: Shard Slam
action.text: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16. Failure: 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage, and the target gains one Contamination level.

fields.description:
A rich outcrop of delerium crystals glimmer from the collapsed ruin nearby. As you approach, the debris begins to shift and move. A hunched, hulking form, one vaguely humanoid, rises up with a chorus of crystalline clinks and grinding rock. The central mass of stone and crystal is supported by two short, stubbly legs of rubble, its arms and shoulders shaped from large boulders of brick and wood that end in balled fists bristling with delerium spikes. Its head, an elongated crystal, is marked by angles and fractures that gradually form into a sorrowful face.

Study the Foe:
Characters proficient in Nature gain Advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks when they Study a Walking Delerium Geode, learning the following based on their result:
(10+) Dense Delerium. You are aware of the elemental's Immunities.
(15+) Pummeled Contamination. Unsurprisingly, hits from this elemental's fists cause Contamination.
(20+) Deadly Destruction. You learn of the creature's Death Burst trait, as well as its strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

Combat Tactics:
The Walking Delerium Geode rests in wait unless disturbed by someone trying to harvest its delerium crystals. Once awoken, it hammers targets with its Shard Slam.

Harvestable Components (Rare):
Animus: Elemental.
Fluid: Contaminated Ichor.
Dust: Elemental Dust.
Delerium: True to its name and nature, characters may be able to collect delerium from the remains of the Walking Delerium Geode, though its destruction tends to cause many crystals to shatter and break. Roll 1d20 to determine what the characters can find:

1: nothing remains but broken splinters and ash;
2-9: 4d6 delerium chips;
10-12: 3d10 delerium fragments;
13-16: 2d6 delerium shards;
17-19: 1d4 delerium crystals;
20: 1 delerium geode.

Source:	Pluto Jackson's Monsters of Drakkenheim p. 49 (Third Party)

fields.name: Eldritch Cataclysm
fields.conditionImmune: burning, exhaustion, frozen, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, shocked, stunned

trait.name: Air Form
trait.text: The eldritch cataclysm can enter a Hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

trait.name: Cyclonic Storm
trait.text: The eldritch cataclysm emits a 120-foot Emanation of high winds that disperse gases and vapors and extinguish unprotected flames. Ranged attacks that pass through the area have Disadvantage. Objects that are not worn or carried are blown away 1d6 x 5 feet in a random direction. A creature that starts its turn in the Emanation is subjected to the following effect. Strength Saving Throw: DC 17 (flying creatures have Disadvantage). Failure: The target has the Slowed condition until the start of its next turn. Failure by 5 or More: The target is flung 1d6 × 5 feet in a random direction, landing with the Prone condition.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
trait.text: This creature is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. This creature may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

trait.name: Haze Adaptation
trait.text: This creature may benefit from a Long Rest finished within the Haze. It can see twice as far through the Haze mists and Deep Haze fog as those without this adaption.

trait.name: Haze Dependence
trait.text: This creature gains one level of Exhaustion for every 24 hours it spends outside the Haze. These Exhaustion levels cannot be removed while the creature is outside the Haze.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
trait.text: As a Utilize action, a monster can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once a monster has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The eldritch cataclysm uses Chain Lighting or Icy Bolt, then uses Meteor Strike or Quake.

action.name: Chain Lightning
action.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +12, range 120 ft. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 7) Lightning damage, the target has the Shocked condition until the end of the cataclysm's next turn, and the lightning leaps to another creature of the cataclysm's choice within 15 feet of the first target. The cataclysm makes a separate Chain Lightning attack against the target. The cataclysm can make any number of Chain Lightning attacks in this way, but a creature can be targeted only once each time the cataclysm takes this action.

action.name: Icy Bolt
action.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +12, range 120 ft. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 7) Cold damage. Hit or Miss: The target and each creature within 5 feet of it are subjected to the following effect. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17. Failure: 18 (4d8) Cold damage, and the target has the Frozen condition (DC 17).

action.name: Meteor Strike
action.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 15-foot radius, 40-foot tall Cylinder centered on a point the cataclysm can see within 120 feet. Failure: 18 (4d8) Fire damage plus 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Quake
action.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from the cataclysm. Failure: 28 (8d6) Thunder damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

fields.description:
A swirling vortex of dark clouds, debris, and icy shards moves in like an eldritch storm. Crackling octarine lightning fills the air, the ground rumbles and shakes with the might of the unnatural weather phenomenon, but this is no ordinary storm. Within the dark clouds appears a snarling face, its eyes and mouth like pools of octarine light. The creature is the weather itself, warped and infused by the Haze of Drakkenheim into an arcane and twisted form of life, filled with the uncaring and unbridled anger of a storm.

Study the Foe:
Characters proficient in Nature or Survival gain Advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks when they Study an Eldritch Cataclysm, learning the following based on their result:
(15+) Amalgamation of Energies. You learn the creature's Immunities, as well as its Air Form trait.
(20+) An Octarine Storm. You recognize its Chain Lightning, Meteor Strike, Quake, and Icy Bolt actions.
(25+) Exceedingly Resilient. You are aware of its strongest and weakest ability scores and saving throws.

Combat Tactics:
Eldritch Cataclysms rule the skies, and never willingly descend to the ground. Instead, it rains down lightning, meteors, and icy blasts from above. The temperamental nature of these elementals means they delight in attacking with a variety of elements, and seldom use the same action two rounds in a row. They enjoy using their Meteor Strike on targets they've Frozen with Icy Bolt, and delight in using their Cyclonic Storm to blow away weapons and equipment dropped by targets of their Chain Lightning.
	These enraged creatures revel in destruction but have little conception that anything could actually pose a threat to them. When confronted with a foe able to withstand their onslaught, they treat it as a personal affront, and furiously focus their subsequent attacks upon them occasionally to the exclusion of all else. Despite this single-minded strategy, an Eldritch Cataclysm can recognize when a creature is resistant or immune to its elemental attacks and tries to use only the most effective powers against its chosen target.

Harvestable Components (Very Rare):
Animus: Elemental.
Fluid: Contaminated Ichor, Elemental Fluid.
Dust: Elemental Dust.

Source:	Pluto Jackson's Monsters of Drakkenheim p. 50 (Third Party)

fields.name: Graffiti
fields.conditionImmune: blinded, charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

trait.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
trait.text: The graffiti is incapacitated while in the area of antimagic. If targeted by Dispel Magic, the graffiti must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the caster's spell save DC or become Unconscious for 1 minute.

trait.name: Regeneration
trait.text: The graffiti regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If the graffiti is splashed with water, targeted by Prestidigitation, or takes Cold damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. Its body is destroyed only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: Solvent Susceptibility
trait.text: The graffiti is instantly destroyed by Universal Solvent.

trait.name: Spider Climb
trait.text: The graffiti can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Surface Bound
trait.text: The graffiti can only move along contiguous flat surfaces, such as walls or floors.

trait.name: Fully Contaminated
trait.text: This creature is immune to Contamination and has Advantage on saving throws against contaminated spells. This creature may cast contaminated spells even though it does not gain Contamination levels.

trait.name: Haze Adaptation
trait.text: This creature may benefit from a Long Rest finished within the Haze. It can see twice as far through the Haze mists and Deep Haze fog as those without this adaption.

trait.name: Haze Dependence
trait.text: This creature gains one level of Exhaustion for every 24 hours it spends outside the Haze. These Exhaustion levels cannot be removed while the creature is outside the Haze.

trait.name: Delerium Healing
trait.text: As a Utilize action, a monster can touch a delerium shard to regain 10 (3d6) Hit Points. Once a monster has used a delerium shard in this way, the shard can't be used in this manner again for 24 hours.

action.name: Satire
action.text: The graffiti shapes itself into a satirical representation of a foe. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature within 60 feet that can see the graffiti. Failure: 10 (3d6) Psychic damage and the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of the graffiti's next turn. Success: Half damage only.

action.name: Transposition
action.text: The air quivers around creatures near the graffiti. Charisma Saving Throw: DC 15, up to five creatures the graffiti can see within 120 feet. Failure: The creature teleports to an unoccupied space capable of supporting the creature within 120 feet.

action.name: Summon Public Opinion (recharge 6)
action.text: The graffiti conjures a swarm of Drakkenheim citizen spirits within 120 feet of itself. The swarm uses the Chorus stat block. The chorus acts immediately after the graffiti on the same Initiative count, and it obeys the graffiti. The chorus disappears after 1 minute or the graffiti dies.

action.name: Spellcasting
action.text:
The graffiti casts one of the following spells,requiring noMaterial components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability(spell save DC 15):

	• At Will: Mage Hand, Minor Illusion
	• 1/day Each: Hallucinatory Terrain, Major Image

fields.spells: mage hand, minor illusion, hallucinatory terrain, major image
fields.description:
Walking through the rubble-strewn city streets, scraps of parchment and bits of faded street art still advertise the events, political intrigues, and foreign affairs of that fateful eve. Broadsheets from the day the meteor struck feature the headline "Queen Lenore's Latest Outfit: Blue or Gold?" while scandals of Elyrian nobility and an interview with the latest champion of the Rex Colosseum dominate below the fold. The nearby debris coalesces into a crowd of figures that press against you, seemingly straining to read the page's changing headline that now reads, "Adventurers Assaulted on the Streets of Drakkenheim!"

Study the Foe:
Characters proficient in Arcana or History gain Advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks when they take the Study action to examine a Graffiti, learning the following based on the result.
(5+) Reforming Words. You learn of the creature's Regeneration ability.
(10+) Manifesting Visions. You recognize the creature's Summon Public Opinion and Transposition abilities.
(15+) Magical Erasure. You are aware of the creature's Solvent Susceptibility and Antimagic Susceptibility traits.

Combat Tactics:
When a creature draws a Graffiti's attention, it uses illusions to confuse its targets. It then uses Summon Public Opinion and watches the drama unfold. To keep things interesting, the Graffiti uses its Transposition ability to see how creatures respond to situations when they're forced to approach them from new perspectives.
	When the graffiti is in the heart of the action, it targets the most influential creature with Satire. Should the graffiti decide its target is sufficiently entertaining, or dangerous, it will flee the situation. If the graffiti is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it plays dead and then escapes at the first opportunity.

Harvestable Components (Rare):
Animus: Construct.
Fluid: Chemical Solution, Elemental Fluid,
Dust: Elemental Dust.

Source:	Pluto Jackson's Monsters of Drakkenheim p. 52 (Third Party)
